parameters.case_seed_policy: The base seed is restarted independently for each case. Within the controlled-spectrum family, identical random factors, reference coefficients, and noise are reused across target condition numbers.

performance_measurements.interpretation: Per-method timing summaries are omitted when a solver fails in any warm-up or timed attempt.
performance_measurements.timing_scope: Public solver call on preconstructed inputs; includes solver input validation and memory preparation, but excludes matrix generation and post-solve metric calculations.
